name: ai-utils
description: Claude Code plugins and agent skills by Eli Robinson

plugins.name: agent-roster
plugins.description: One shared map from job kind to agent kind for coordinator chats. Native subagents (ticket writer, researcher, lookup, engine and UI implementers, mechanical editor, copy writer, read-only review-gate critics, PR finisher), each pinned to its model, plus a route-work skill with the routing table and coordinator rules, Cursor's thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review skill (vendored, MIT) for the thermonuclear reviewer, and a setup-agentic-workflow skill that installs the worktree, review-gate and merge rules, the ticketing tool setting, the reviewers and two guard hooks into a repo, plus a coordinator prompt template.

plugins.name: asks-board
plugins.description: One claude.ai artifact board for the asks your Claude chats need you to settle with a click. Chats add asks; your clicks ping the asking chat through one Board Router chat. Includes the daily-use skill and a setup skill with the board page template.

plugins.name: mutation-guided-testing
plugins.description: Opt-in proof of concept: makes the tests an agent writes catch bugs, not just raise coverage. Inside the red-green-refactor loop it names 3 to 5 concrete bugs from a risk checklist before the code, proves a test fails for each, runs Gremlins, mutmut or StrykerJS on the diff only, and triages a capped, ranked list of survivors. No percentage gate.
